context: Hiroshi formally retires; Kenji says farewell.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 部長、本当に、感謝、本当に。
lines.en: Boss — thank you, truly, from the bottom of my heart.
lines.style: Warm, respectful bow in the voice. Soft attack on gratitude. Breath visible beneath the words. Steady eye-contact through vulnerability. Not performed — genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Firm but not cold. A beat of weight behind the words. Direct gaze. The kind of reply that makes everything unsaid understood. Command held gently.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一緒に、ここまで、来た、宝。
lines.en: Coming this far together — it's been a treasure.
lines.style: Soft opening. The words come slowly, measured. Almost philosophical — looking back, not just forward. Slight tremor held underneath. Genuine awe in the pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人生、お前と、過ごせて、幸せ。
lines.en: I've been happy to spend this time with you.
lines.style: Direct but not distant. Warmth underneath firmness. The words land with quiet weight. Composed exhale. A man saying something true without needing it repeated back.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: You are someone truly precious to me.
lines.style: Whisper-soft opening. Pause before the word precious. Voice catches slightly — barely audible. Humility and depth in equal measure. Trailing into quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Keep trying, keep going — from here on.
lines.style: A command wrapped in belief. Firm but not harsh. The words carry forward momentum. Brief, clear, and absolute. A promise disguised as an instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Immediate, solid commitment. No hesitation. Breath drawn in with resolve. The words stack firm and forward. A vow, not a reply. Slight bow in the voice.
